title: That there is no idol in the world (opening)
english: Honor paid to the God who truly is is somehow also an honor of the one who honors; but honor paid to the god who is not is, by contrast, a dishonor of the very one who honors.
translator_notes: Copy-text PG 10 Khazarzar (Eis to ouden eidolon en kosmo). PD.
True OET; Pass A ≠ Pass B. Melito skipped; never Cyril Matthew densify.
Whole surviving scrap is one sentence; tip is the complete fragment.
